verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an inference-serving runtime, so serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill, or throughput tuning. Distributed GPU worker nodes and horizontal scaling are a different capability and earn no credit here.
